protocol.name: Frozen context-rule candidate held-out validation v1
protocol.status: Awaiting user review of labels; no inference performed
protocol.label_approval: Record user approval in a separate review artifact tied to exact case text, references and labels. Pending labels block inference. Do not alter candidate based on these cases.
protocol.disclosure: Criteria recorded after inspecting draft labels but before any held-out inference. Candidate code unchanged since development challenges. These synthetic pairs are correlated and not a population sample.
execution: Verify frozen source, dependencies, model digest and reviewed labels before starting.
One attempt per case in existing order; send only input text through frozen check_sentence, then frozen explain_change.
Save raw model output, derived edits, rule decision, offered explanation, errors and per-stage elapsed time after each attempt.
Preserve interrupted/failed attempts; never silently regenerate them or choose the best repeat.
References and expected_error are scoring-only, never model input. Create a human output review after inference.

metrics.useful: Correct necessary correction, preserves meaning, no extra errors or changes, and accurate understandable explanation. Human review required; reference matching is diagnostic.
metrics.coverage: All 20 erroneous inputs remain denominator, including no proposal, withheld, service/parse failures.
metrics.precision: Human-correct offered corrections divided by all offered corrections; undefined for zero offers, never 100%.
metrics.baseline: 12/20 is a 60% minimum gate, slightly above the earlier development 17/30. This is not a same-input superiority comparison to that baseline.
metrics.timing: Time generation, rule checks and total processing separately in the same run. Report median/p95/max, first call separately, failures separately. No claim of complete voice latency or meeting two seconds.

protocol.decision: Any gate failure blocks adoption. Even a pass only supports a limited follow-up pilot; it does not establish broad language support or the voice latency goal. Treat any subsequent tuning on these outputs as development and obtain new untouched cases for independent validation.

dataset.source: Original synthetic held-out pairs; all 40 labels approved by project owner. Correlated pairs, not representative of a population.
